title: OneCoin Webniar - 26.05.2016, English
description: OneCoin Webinar hosted by Paul Smith - 26.05.2016.

asr.full_text: hello from myself, Paul Smith, welcome to this week's State of the Nation broadcast for Thursday the 26th May. We are so close to two milestones our founder and CEO birthday this coming Monday celebrated by special promotion and of course our mega global event in London. As we come to the end of May we stand on the edge of 1.9 million members, these are incredible times! The 555 limited package is a time-limited offer that will be available for only 555 Limited Offer will automatically transfer 555 1Coins to the member's OneXchange account. Like the Infinity Plus package, all coins in this package will be transferred to your CoinSafe account. This exclusive offer grants access to all 6 levels of Modular Financial Education and gives extended rights in the OneCoin platform to practice, mine, and trade. To commemorate the upcoming birthday of Onecoin's founder and visionary doctor Ruja Ignatova. 10% of all profits generated from the triple five limited offer will be donated to the OneWorld Foundation to aid its development and ensure a better life for future generations. this package deal expires on the 30th of May 2016. Following extensive work we are proud to introduce the Split Calculator. It is located in the bottom right-hand corner of your back office. This amazing tool gives you the chance to calculate the precise number of splits you will receive with each different package upgrade thus ensuring there is no more confusion. Now each and every one coin member will have the chance to personally check how many splits he or she will receive and choose the best option to receive a maximum number of coins. and then you go to the bonus section. It's here on the left side, where you can check how many splits he or she will receive or choose the best option to receive maximum coins. Do note that the Plus One Split promotion is still active for another ten days. If you upgrade to an Infinity Package from Tycoon, Premium or Festival by June the 5th 2016 you'll get one extra split on top of what the upgrade initially gives you! Make sure you take advantage of this generous offer in time. Visit your back office and upgrade your package now. The excitement is building and all eyes are turning to London There's now only two weeks to go until the most anticipated event of the year, The Coin Rush. You and your fellow members must attend this event and remember to help you with extending ticket promotion to give you all the chance to get free tickets. If you buy 10 tickets from the same category, you can get one free. Do see the special Coin Rush website for up to date information. Make sure you book your seats as soon as possible before they're sold out. In order to show our gratitude to our most dedicated supporters we're giving all members with Diamond rank and above two free tickets for the event. Keep in mind that if you reach Diamond Rank within the next month, you'll also receive two free tickets. There are three ticket categories bronze at 100 euros silver at 150 euros and gold at 200 euros. The ticket classification is based on the proximity to the stage. The higher the category the closer you will be to the stage. Be sure to keep an eye on your backend news section we'll keep you up to date with all the be to the stage. Keep an eye in our backend news section where we will keep you up to date with all the information about the event. We are looking forward to seeing you there. Onecoin's rapid global expansion continues. This time the ONECOIN family is entering one of the most prosperous financial markets in Asia, Japan. Due to the regulations all members are obliged to start by purchasing a starter package after which they'll be able to upgrade to other packages. All Japanese members will still have a 20 day cancellation right after purchasing the package. The cancellation period is valid only for the starter package. Additionally, all members with a starter package can get access to all OneCoin opportunities including the first level of OneAcademy. OneCoin's strong presence in Asia was reaffirmed this week with the Grand Event in Cambodia. Over 2,000 enthusiastic members from all over the world fill the hall in the capital, Phnom Penh, on Saturday. The event was organized with a mix of cultural displays and informal presentations of OneCoin, One Academy and One World Foundation including a performance by the children from the Cambodian Amphinage which is supported by One World Foundation. This also turned out to be a groundbreaking event in One-Coin's history as the first 5 packages of the new Triple Five got auctioned out by our global master distributor Sebastian Greenwood and our global Ambassador Yuha Periello. The five package were auctioned for a total of 325,000 euros benefiting the One World Foundation. We have just filmed and published an exclusive interview between Dr Roosje and key leaders See it in your back-office. As we continue to say, a great way to drive your business is by collecting free package codes, codes that you can use yourself or utilize to motivate others in your business. Our free packages promotion continues with you able to get up to a 27 and a half thousand Euro package for free. If you bank eight Infinity Codes you'll get up to a 27 and a half thousand euro package for free If you bank 8 Infinity codes, you'll get 1 Infinity code free If you bank 10 Premium codes, you'll get 1 Premium code free If you bank 10 Tycoon codes, you'll get 1 Tycoon code free If you bank 6 Premium codes, you'll get 3 pro trader codes free and our 6 plus 1 Champion the Kohn Vegas promotion related only to its top package gives you an extra Champion code if you bank in 6 Champion codes. As we always say, in order to get the free package or packages you need to be clear in your communication with the accounting department of the company. First you need to accumulate the right amount of codes related to the specified package or packages to get the free promotional code or codes. Secondly reports the accounting department and all the codes you banked in in one payment. Remember to explain which codes correspond to which payments when you send the bank while. Onecoin's biggest Balkan event this week are you ready for a week and on leadership boot camp and an open public event with Ed Ludbrook, Kari Walrus and Michail Petrovic? This coming Saturday will take you to another level and help you reach your momentum with some of the best leaders in the industry. Years of experience in team management and leadership building strategies will be shared with those lucky ones who save their seat in the audience. Bring your prospects and join the revolution of finance and make it happen. The event takes place in Belgrade in Serbia this weekend. As we invest in and build our support of you, our members, a reminder that you can now send in your questions and have them answered in German, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese. Send your message to each of the corresponding email addresses you see on the slide. This brings this week stage in the nation to an end and only a few weeks to coin rush. You just have to be there. I'll be back next week to update you on the other parts of this process . Visit The OneCoin Webinars YouTube channel http://onecoin-sotn.com Visit my website at http://onecoin.sotn.com For more information go to http:// 1coin-SOTN.com website with of course our Chinese language voiceover as well as English. Until next week all the best from the whole 1coin team.

textual.observation: The speaker promotes an Infinity Package upgrade that promises one additional split when upgrading from specified packages before June 5, 2016, and directly instructs members to upgrade.

evidence.quote: If you upgrade to an Infinity Package from Tycoon, Premium or Festival by June the 5th 2016 you'll get one extra split on top of what the upgrade initially gives you!
Visit your back office and upgrade your package now.

textual.context: Presented as an active promotional offer by the webinar speaker.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised additional platform asset is explicitly linked to upgrading a package and acting before a stated deadline, which may require later assessment of the offer's terms and conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the monetary cost of the upgrade, the nature or value of a split, whether the offer was fulfilled, or any resulting loss or outcome.

textual.observation: The speaker promotes free package codes, including a package stated to be worth up to 27,500 euros, conditional on accumulating specified codes and reporting them to the company's accounting department in one payment.

evidence.quote: Our free packages promotion continues with you able to get up to a 27 and a half thousand Euro package for free.
First you need to accumulate the right amount of codes related to the specified package or packages to get the free promotional code or codes.
Secondly reports the accounting department and all the codes you banked in in one payment.

textual.context: Presented as a promotional business opportunity; the speaker gives procedural instructions for obtaining the stated free package.
textual.potential_relevance: A high-value promised package is linked to accumulating multiple codes and submitting them through a specified one-payment process, creating a concrete reward, action, and payment-related relationship for later review.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what the codes represent, the required payment amount, eligibility beyond the stated code counts, whether the package was delivered, or any financial outcome.

visual.observation: A promotion slide says "GET AN EXTRA SPLIT TODAY > AVAILABLE TILL 5TH JUNE 2016" and shows "+1 SPLIT BONUS" above trader package tiers priced at €5500, €13 750, and €27 500.
visual.context: Visible context is a OneCoin-branded presentation slide labeled "State of the Nation PROMOTIONS"; promotion versus discussion beyond the slide context is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship is a bonus/reward claim tied on the same slide to euro-priced package tiers and a specific availability deadline.
visual.limitations: The sampled frame does not show the purchase flow, define what a "split" means, identify who would receive the bonus, or establish whether any transaction occurred.

visual.observation: A promotion slide says "GET A FREE PACKAGE CODE!" and lists conditions such as banking 8 Infinity codes to get 1 Infinity code free, banking 10 Premium or Tycoon codes to get 1 free code, and banking other code combinations for extra codes.
visual.context: Visible context is a OneCoin-branded presentation slide labeled "State of the Nation PROMOTIONS" with the conditional offers written as promotional bullet points.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship is a free package/code reward explicitly linked to the requested action of "banking" multiple package codes under specified quantity conditions.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not define "bank" or the codes, show where the action is performed, show payment or account steps, or establish whether the stated free codes were delivered.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source includes a stated cancellation qualification for Japanese starter-package purchasers.

evidence.quote: All Japanese members will still have a 20 day cancellation right after purchasing the package.
The cancellation period is valid only for the starter package.

visual_context_notes.observation: A separate OneCoin slide shows "JAPAN OPEN" with "Starter Package" and a stated "20 Day Right of Cancellation."
Several slides are visibly organized as a OneCoin "State of the Nation" presentation with sections labeled "PROMOTIONS," "EVENTS," and "NEWS."
An event slide titled "ONECOIN GLOBAL EVENT: COIN RUSH" shows ticket categories and prices plus routine free-ticket offers for Diamond rank members and buying 10 tickets.
A later event slide advertises a Belgrade, Serbia OneCoin event and includes a visible QR code area labeled "GET YOUR TICKETS."

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it directly promotes time-limited OneCoin packages and upgrades, presenting coin transfers and access to mining and trading while urging members to act before the offers expire. It also recruits participation through a business hierarchy by telling members to bring prospects, motivate others, accumulate package codes, and pursue rank-linked benefits. The supplied material does not show a completed loss, but it clearly contains an active package-purchase and recruitment solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promotion frames participation as a member business dependent on recruiting prospects and motivating others, with package-code accumulation and rank-linked benefits. The video therefore promotes a multi-person recruitment and qualification structure rather than merely describing an ordinary product or financial news.

evidence.observation: The presenter promotes a time-limited package offer.
evidence.quote: The 555 limited package is a time-limited offer

evidence.observation: The package is presented as providing platform access and mining/trading-related rights.
evidence.quote: This exclusive offer grants access to all 6 levels of Modular Financial Education and gives extended rights in the OneCoin platform to practice, mine, and trade.

evidence.observation: The presenter explicitly encourages members to recruit prospects.
